value.rationale: Provides a precise sharp sample-complexity envelope for an important smooth-but-nonanalytic transform of an unbounded Gaussian expectation under a natural heavy-tail proposal. The matching barrier differentiates a genuinely Gevrey convergence regime from ordinary arbitrarily-high Sobolev algebraic bounds and is usable for choosing an integration budget without claiming global optimality.
